params.name: include-iso3
params.description: Include ISO 3-letter country codes and ISO 3-letter currency codes in the data. These will be added to columns 10 and 11 respectively

params.name: include-8digit
params.description: Include 8-digit and higher BIN codes. This option includes all 6-digit BINs and all 8-digit and higher BINs (including some 9, 10 and 11 digit BINs where available)

params.name: include-all
params.description: Include all BINs and all available fields in the CSV file (overrides any values set for 'include-iso3' or 'include-8digit')

params.name: output-encoding
params.description: Set this option to 'gzip' to have the output file compressed using gzip

items.docs: Download our entire BIN database for direct use on your own systems

params.name: from-type
params.description: The type of the value to convert from (e.g. USD)

params.name: to-type
params.description: The type to convert to (e.g. EUR)

params.name: historical-date
params.description: Convert using the rate on a historical date, accepted date formats are: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY. Historical rates are stored with daily granularity so the date format YYYY-MM-DD is preferred for the highest precision. If an invalid date or a date too far into the past is supplied then the API will respond with 'valid' as false and an empty 'historical-date'

params.name: bin-number
params.description: The BIN or IIN number. This is the first 6, 8 or 10 digits of a card number, use 8 (or more) digits for the highest level of accuracy

params.name: customer-ip
params.description: Pass in the customers IP address and we will return some extra information about them
